label: Bible Study
prompt: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be _____ from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verse: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
note: Paul's confident hope — away from the body means at home with the Lord.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to _____;
verse: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
note: God giveth us richly all things to enjoy — Paul's reminder to trust the Giver, not the riches.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen _____.
verse: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
note: The oxen stumbled and Uzza reached out to steady the ark — a lesson that God's holy things are carried his way.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a _____ plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verse: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
note: Spared like a burning stick pulled from a fire — and still Israel didn't return to God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore doth a living man _____, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verse: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
note: The same chapter that sings 'great is thy faithfulness' asks why a living man should 'complain' about the punishment of his sins.
